documents.title: Is using ChatGPT for coursework considered cheating?
documents.quality_note: A short library FAQ answer: each instructor sets policy, and passing off ChatGPT writing as your own violates integrity principles. It is not an official policy, but it states the student-facing rule in plain terms.

notes: The known URL from the earlier pass was a single course page (CSI 3334, cs.baylor.edu/~hamerly), which is deferred. No Department of Computer Science or School of Engineering and Computer Science (ecs.baylor.edu) AI policy found; the ECS pages in search results describe AI research and the MS in AI, not use policy. The Baylor Lariat piece on the AI committee is news and was not collected. The libguides faculty AI page (libguides.baylor.edu/facultyguide/genai) lists library AI tools (Scopus AI etc.), not policy, and was not collected. Course syllabi deferred.
